jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
jobs.description: Overview Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering. Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit. The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era. We have one product: new physics, at scale. Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact. Â Role and Responsibilities Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting. The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on. Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first. We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit. What We're Looking For A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials. Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list. You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently. A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically. Nice to Have Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security. Experience in research or scientific computing environments. Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem. Â How We Work We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage. Â Location and Compensation This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery. Proficiency with spoken and written English. Fluency with Git. Overlap with working hours in the Eastern time zone. Average availability of at least 30 hours per week, preferably 35 hours or more. jobs.title: Senior Independent Software Developer
jobs.description: You must be located in the Americas, Europe, or Israel to apply. A·Team is a VC-backed, stealth, application-only home on the internet for senior independent software builders to team up with hand-picked, high-growth companies on their next big thing. After talking with hundreds of independent engineers, designers, and product folks, we heard over and over that finding vetted, high-quality, consistent clients is hard, and projects are often too small to be rewarding. A·Team matches small teams of the most talented builders in the world with companies backed by a16z, YC, Softbank, General Catalyst, etc. on a contract basis for many of their most important initiatives. We quietly launched in May 2020, and have helped A·Teamers earn $85+ million since. As part of A·Team, you can expect: High-paying, meaningful missions with the most audacious companies sent your way; generally $90-$150+/hr, with vetted, fascinating clients doing work that matters. We're picky about who we partner with; new clients only come in via trusted referral. We've worked with Lyft, McGraw Hill, ClearCo, Pepsi, Walmart, the former CEO of Waze, the leading vaccine production software, several new unicorns we can't say here, and dozens of startups backed by a16z/YC/Softbank/Insight/Tiger/etc. Work alongside friends old & new: our niche is small/diverse product teams, since clients with larger budgets and higher-impact work tell us they want teams, not individuals. Of course, we keep friends together whenever we can. Full autonomy: say "no" to things that don't excite you. The most talented builders often juggle a few things at once, so there's never pressure to join an A·Team mission if you don't have the bandwidth. If we're no longer a fit, it's easy to leave or pause too. Small, curated, off-the-record gatherings: for conversations hard to have elsewhere. Long-term, we're creating micro-communities for the world's top builders to become friends around the things they care about. Keep 100% of what you earn: if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on top of your rate. How to apply: Go here: https://build.a.team/remotivereferral + mention Remotive. We respect your time so the application is short. We're also much more interested in seeing what you've made, and excited to chat more if there’s a fit. What you’ll do: Once part of A.Team, you’ll regularly be invited to impactful missions that match your interests. Find the right pick from early-stage incubations with world-class founders, to fast-growing super-funded companies, to old school non-tech incumbents looking to build as a tech giant would Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team. You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction. Who A · Team is for: Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy. Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders. The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing Who A · Team is not for: People looking for small gigs Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites Those still early in their careers (<4 years) and recent university/bootcamp grads (at least not yet) Our long-term vision: A·Team is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. jobs.title: Optimization and Forecast Engineer - Energy Systems (f/m/d)
jobs.description: About FION European industry is losing competitiveness because electricity here is more expensive and more volatile than in the US or China. The reason: renewables fluctuate strongly, factories consume constantly. We close that gap. FION plans and installs the right battery system for an industrial site and runs it with AI in real time against tariffs and markets. The software that dimensions, controls and monitors those systems is our own, and it runs end to end: ML and optimization in the cloud, data streaming and control, and the edge device at the customer site. The result for the customer: significantly lower energy costs and measurable CO2 savings. We earn trust by delivering systems and operating them transparently. We already work with more than 20 factories across industries such as plastics, automotive and food processing, and we are backed by early-stage investors. We're looking for an engineer with deep experience in time-series forecasting and mathematical optimization to join us as an early hire. You'll work on the forecasting and optimization core of our platform: the models that forecast industrial electricity consumption and PV generation, and the optimization that decides how each battery operates and trades against tariffs and markets within physical and grid constraints. This is a startup role: you should be comfortable switching between strategic thinking and hands-on work. You'll work directly with the CTO, one of the co-founders. Tasks Forecasting models Develop and improve time-series forecasting models for industrial electricity consumption, PV generation, and other energy-relevant signals, and extend them with probabilistic outputs. Evaluate forecast quality on noisy, incomplete, and non-stationary industrial data, including its actual operational and economic impact. Battery dispatch optimization Develop and improve the optimization models that schedule battery dispatch across peak shaving, self-consumption, spot market trading and flexibility marketing, while adhering to physical and grid constraints. Design how forecasts, uncertainty measures, physical constraints, and system states are used in downstream optimization workflows. Validation, simulation and monitoring Build and improve simulation, replay, benchmarking, and validation workflows to test model behavior before and alongside deployment in live systems. Build and use tools and processes to monitor and assess the quality of operational forecasting and optimization models. Production integration Design, write, test, and deploy production-grade code for mission-critical forecasting and optimization products. Improve robustness through plausibility checks, fallback behavior, re-forecasting, and handling of low-confidence or missing data. Collaborate closely with software engineers to integrate models into our core platform and edge devices. Requirements You bring: - 5+ years of professional software engineering experience - Strong applied experience in time-series and probabilistic forecasting: forecast calibration, uncertainty evaluation, backtesting, and model validation - Strong understanding of mathematical optimization, especially LP/MILP, and the ability to model real-world systems through objectives, constraints, and operational rules - Strong Python skills with the scientific and machine learning tool stack (pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch) - Experience developing, releasing, and tracking the performance of forecasting or optimization models in a commercial software setting - An ownership mindset - you want to shape the platform, not just implement tickets Even better if you have: - Energy domain knowledge - you understand power, energy, phases, and how the grid works - Understanding of European electricity markets, flexibility services, and grid operation - BESS-specific experience: familiarity with BESS architectures, components, and operation, and direct experience with energy management algorithms for battery systems -

jobs.title: Operations Intern for AVD (Altersvorsorgedepot) (f/m/d)
jobs.description: At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business. We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience. About the role: Germany's private pension system is being rebuilt from the ground up. From 1 January 2027, the Altersvorsorgedepot (AVD) replaces the Riester-Rente as the country's state-subsidised private pension and Upvest is building the operational infrastructure that lets fintechs and banks offer it to millions of savers. Join us as an AVD Operations Intern and you'll be there before Day 1: helping design the processes, then running them once they go live. This is a rare chance to see a regulated financial product being built from a blank page, rather than inheriting one that already works. What you’ll do: Support day-to-day AVD operations: Help run the core processes that keep the product working, e.g. contract registration with the ZfA (Zentrale Zulagenstelle für Altersvermögen), contribution management, the annual bonus application (AZ01), and payment reconciliation. You'll learn how a state-subsidised pension product actually functions behind the interface. Help build the playbooks: As we prepare for launch, we're writing the processes from scratch. You'll help document workflows, build step-by-step guides and error catalogues, and keep them current as the rules and our systems evolve; the foundations the team will scale on. Support error handling and reconciliation: Work through recurring error cases from the ZfA, check that payments and records match, and help spot the patterns behind repeat issues so they can be fixed at the root rather than one at a time. Support our client teams: Our partners' support teams field questions from their end-users about subsidies, transfers and payouts. You'll help prepare clear, accurate answers and learn to translate dense regulation into language a customer can act on. Spot what should be better: You'll see every manual workaround first-hand. We want your view on what's slow, error-prone, or worth automating; and you'll have the room to say so. What you bring: You are fluent in German (C1 or above) and comfortable working in English. This one is a hard requirement rather than a nice-to-have: the regulation, the correspondence with the ZfA, and most of the documentation you'll work with day to day are all in German. You're a student in Business, Economics, Finance, Law, or a related field — or on a gap year between degrees. You're structured and genuinely precise. In this role, small details carry real consequences for someone's pension, and you're the kind of person who notices when a number doesn't add up. You're curious about rules rather than put off by them. You're willing to read the actual regulation to understand why a process works the way it does. You're comfortable with ambiguity. The product is brand new, so some answers don't exist yet; you'll ask good questions instead of waiting for perfect instructions. You're confident with spreadsheets. Any prior exposure to financial services, operations or a regulated environment is a bonus, but not required. You're available for a minimum of 4 mont

jobs.description: Baue einen skalierbaren Customer-Success-Bereich auf Novo AI ist ein Technologieunternehmen aus Hannover. Damit unsere Kunden schnell starten und unsere Lösungen im Alltag sicher nutzen können, bauen wir unser Onboarding und Customer Success von Grund auf auf. Du kannst Verbesserungen selbst vorantreiben und arbeitest dabei mit Kollegen zusammen, die dich bei der Umsetzung unterstützen. Unser Ziel: mehr Kunden gut begleiten und den manuellen Aufwand pro Kunde reduzieren. Du baust eine gut auffindbare Wissensbasis auf, mit der Kunden typische Fragen selbst klären können. Du nutzt passende digitale Werkzeuge und setzt um, was du selbst umsetzen kannst. Programmierung, Schnittstellen und komplexere technische Umsetzung übernimmst du gemeinsam mit unseren technischen Kollegen; du musst dafür nicht selbst programmieren können. Du gestaltest das Onboarding verständlich, in passenden Schritten und ohne Informationsüberflutung. jobs.description: Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO We are looking for a Senior Product Manager ( ISR ) (f/m/x) to own the product and delivery side of LiveEO's defence and intelligence business. Sektion 4 builds AI-based ISR capabilities for German and allied defence and intelligence customers: object and change detection in very high resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain products derived from stereo imagery, and the analytics that turn imagery into decisions. You will run our customer-facing defence products end to end from a product management perspective including analytical products as well as end user applications. You will also build the roadmap that connects different customer timelines, our concept of operations and the actual maturity of our technical components into one plan that engineering and sales both work from. This role exists because our LiveEO engineers build world class AI models and your work will help to bring them into operations and roll them out to many more end users. We need someone who can say how an analyst does the job, write requirements a military user would recognise, and hold the line on what we ship. LiveEO is a dynamic team that thrives on big challenges and fast learning cycles. We move quickly, stay curious, and genuinely enjoy building together. We are on a mission to break the "curse of Earth Observation": turning incredible satellite data into reliable, actionable decisions that people can trust and use in real operations on scale. You will be part of Sektion 4, LiveEO's government-solutions product team. Sektion 4 owns its roadmap and delivers funded R&D projects and defence engagements end-to-end, from research through to production, and sets its own technical direction. You will work day to day with the team's ML engineergs, full-stack engineers and geospatial data egineers, and across LiveEO with sales, pre-sales and the teams building the Twinspector satellite programme. Externally you are in front of military and agency users, partners and integrators, in workshops, requirement sessions and user tests. Your challenge As Product Manager (f/m/x), you own what we build for defence and intelligence customers, and you are accountable for it reaching them. Own the ISR product: take our imagery intelligence application from working demonstrator to deployable product. Define the release scope, the deployment and support model for secure on-premise environments, and drive the first installation at a real user. Run the backlog: work with the engineering team in two-week sprints. Translate operational needs into written requirements and user stories, prioritise ruthlessly, cut scope when it is the right call, and keep the team pointed at what matters. Deliver defence projects end to end: own scope, milestones, deliverables and stakeholder communication for our customer-facing defence engagements, and take on new projects as the pipeline converts. Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not. 4. You are the legal authority in the building. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough. Your profile The person we picture. jobs.title: Werkstudent Automatisierung, KI & Workflows im Enterprise Risk Management (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Dein neues Team: Du willst verstehen, wie ein modernes FinTech Risiken steuert und gleichzeitig mit Automatisierung und KI echte Prozessverbesserungen bauen? Im Enterprise Risk Management von auxmoney arbeitest Du in unserer GRC-Plattform (OneTrust) an Workflows, Integrationen und smarten, KI-gestützten Abläufen, die Risikomanagement effizienter und transparenter machen. Wir berichten direkt an den CFO und bündeln Themen wie Internes Kontrollsystem, operationelle Risiken, Incidents, Drittparteien sowie wiederkehrende Bestätigungen der Fachbereiche an einem zentralen Ort. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Team und den Fachbereichen zusammen, übernimmst früh Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Informationen strukturiert erfasst, Aufgaben sauber verteilt und Statusdaten ohne manuelles Nachfassen ins Reporting fließen. Das erwartet Dich: Workflows konfigurieren: Du entwickelst Workflows in unserer GRC-Software OneTrust, von der Analyse des Ablaufs bis zur fertigen Konfiguration mit Datenfeldern, Statuslogiken, Verantwortlichkeiten, Eskalationen und automatischen Benachrichtigungen. Systeme integrieren: Du verbindest OneTrust über Schnittstellen und moderne Workflow-Tools mit weiteren Systemen bei auxmoney, zum Beispiel Slack, SharePoint oder Outlook, damit Fachbereiche Statusupdates dort liefern können, wo sie ohnehin arbeiten. Automatisierungen aufbauen: Du identifizierst wiederkehrende Handgriffe und ersetzt sie durch Automatisierungen, die Informationen anfordern, Aufgaben verteilen, Fristen überwachen und Folgeaktivitäten auslösen, etwa bei regelmäßigen Bestätigungen der Fachbereiche oder bei der Überprüfung unserer Dienstleister. KI sinnvoll einsetzen: Du baust mit unseren KI-Bausteinen konkrete Lösungen für das Risikomanagement, zum Beispiel zur Strukturierung von Informationen, zur Vorbereitung von Bewertungen, zum Erkennen fehlender Angaben oder zum Zusammenfassen von Berichten, und achtest dabei auf Nachvollziehbarkeit und Qualität. Qualität absichern: Du entwickelst Testfälle, prüfst Workflow-Logiken und KI-Lösungen vor dem Einsatz und dokumentierst Konfigurationen, Schnittstellen und Abhängigkeiten so, dass andere darauf aufbauen können. Reporting verbessern: Du sorgst dafür, dass Informationen vollständig und strukturiert erfasst werden, und überführst Statusdaten automatisiert in klare Übersichten für Management und Board. Flexibel arbeiten: Du arbeitest flexibel aus dem Homeoffice. Wenn Du in der Nähe von Düsseldorf studierst, triffst Du Dein Team einmal pro Woche im Büro, ansonsten sehen wir uns regelmäßig digital und zu gemeinsamen Team-Tagen vor Ort. Das bringst Du mit: Immatrikulation und Praxis: Du bist in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Data Science, Business Analytics, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang immatrikuliert und hast bereits praktisch mit Software, Automatisierungen oder Daten gearbeitet, zum Beispiel im Studium, im Nebenjob oder in eigenen Projekten. Technisches Verständnis: Du hast Freude daran, neue Software zu verstehen, Workflows zu konfigurieren und technische Zusammenhänge zu durchdringen. AWS expertise : You have strong hands-on experience with AWS and cloud-native infrastructure. Go experience : You have professional experience with Go (Golang), ideally for automation, platform tooling, or backend services. Distributed systems : You understand distributed systems, asynchronous processing, and event streaming. Engineering excellence : You are experienced with automation, infrastructure as code, continuous delivery, observability, security, and reliability. Technical leadership : You can make sound architectural decisions and explain technical trade-offs clearly Delivery mindset : You have experience leading technical initiatives and delivering complex work incrementally. Collaboration and mentoring : You enjoy working with others, sharing knowledge, and supporting the growth of your colleagues. Backed by the strength of MGM Resorts International and LeoVegas Group, we're bringing the gold standard of entertainment to disrupt the sector. As we scale rapidly, we are building a world-class local team, and performance insights are at the heart of our commercial strategy. The Commercial Performance Analyst is not just a data expert, but a commercial leader with consultancy-level problem-solving skills to join our high-performing RoW analytics function. You will operate across all business functions - from marketing and product to operations and finance - with a clear mission: to understand, optimise, and grow how the business makes money. This role blends deep analytical expertise with strategic advisory capability, delivering insights that shape decision-making, drive revenue, and improve operational efficiency. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: Lead and mentor Commercial Analysts providing guidance and support. Act as a strategic partner to functional leaders (Marketing, Product, CRM, Pricing, Risk, Operations, Finance) to identify growth opportunities and operational efficiencies. jobs.description: What is the job? We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Analytics to help us uncover what’s truly driving growth, understand where the biggest opportunities lie and shape where we focus next. This is a high-impact, hands-on senior individual contributor role for someone who loves getting under the skin of the data, connecting the dots behind performance and turning complex findings into clear, commercially meaningful action. You’ll be equally excited by the technical side of analytics - working with data, tools and reporting infrastructure - as you are by solving real business problems and influencing decisions. Working closely with teams across paid media, CRM and lifecycle marketing, you’ll become a trusted partner to the wider marketing function. You’ll help us understand how our channels and campaigns are performing, identify the behaviours and trends that matter, and provide the insight needed to make smarter decisions about investment, optimisation and growth. This is much more than a reporting role. You’ll challenge assumptions, ask the questions others may not have considered and bring clarity to complex or ambiguous problems. You’ll help shape how we measure success, improve the quality and accessibility of our marketing data, and build a stronger understanding of the full customer journey. We’re looking for someone who is naturally curious, commercially minded and confident working independently. You’ll be comfortable setting your own direction, prioritising the work that will create the greatest value and getting on with delivering meaningful, measurable impact. What will you be doing? Partner with marketing teams to provide clear, actionable insights on performance across channels including Google, Meta, Social and CRM. Analyse marketing spend and outcomes to support optimisation and better decision-making. Own and evolve our GA4 setup, ensuring tracking is robust and focused on meaningful performance metrics. Work with CRM teams to analyse lifecycle journeys, retention, and engagement using a variety of data sources. Act as the internal owner for marketing data requirements, working with Analytics Engineers to ensure data models and dashboards meet real business needs. Lead the development of advanced measurement, beyond basic attribution, moving from LTV and CAC towards incrementality. Communicate insights clearly through dashboards, presentations, and conversations with senior stakeholders. What do you need? Experience with digital analytics, ideally in a fast-paced or growth-focused environment. Hands-on experience with SQL is a must, BigQuery, GA4, Looker, and Google Sheets are a plus. Comfortable working across a broad marketing function and building strong relationships with non-technical stakeholders. Experience collaborating with data or analytics engineering teams, clearly defining requirements and translating insight into action. A confident communicator who can explain complex analysis in simple, practical terms. You’re able to identify the what and the why to help shape decisions. Self-starter mindset - able to navigate ambiguity and work independently. Experience with Braze or similar CRM platforms is a strong advantage. jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Executive, London
jobs.description: We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science. We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world. World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached. Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you. ABOUT THE ROLE Open to hiring remote in London, UK. You will carry a book of 40-60 mid-market and emerging accounts - companies in the <$1B range, closing 25-40 deals a year at $40k-$100k and building toward larger standard deal sizes as our packaging moves upmarket. You work in a pod with a dedicated Mid-Market Engagement Manager on a shared book, with a comp plan designed to maximize earnings and customer value. We are architecting the best GTM team in all of AI. If you want to grow, run fast, and sell with a leading-edge frontier AI company with room to grow your career, please apply. WHAT YOU'LL DO Run a high-velocity full-cycle motion: 25-40 closed deals a year across inbound and outbound Qualify hard and fast - your book is big, your calendar is the scarce resource, orientation to clear ROI and value orientation is a must Push deal size up: committed-volume, use-case expansion plays that turn $30k starts into $100k+ repeatable motions Turn product signals (usage spikes, team signups, credit burn) into pipeline Work with your pod's Engagement Manager so new customers hit consumption targets and your held-back commission unlocks WHAT YOU'LL NEED 3+ years of full-cycle closing experience in SaaS/AI with a quota record above 100% Velocity evidence: 20+ closed deals a year, multi-channel prospecting, disciplined qualification Native AI-tool fluency - you already sell with AI in your workflow, not despite it Writing and demo skills strong enough to carry a deal without a solutions engineer Coachability with a track record: name the coaching that changed your numbers STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO HAVE Sold to creative or marketing teams PLG or usage-signal selling experience BDR-to-AE promotion in your history - we like people who earned the chair COMPENSATION OTE $270K - $300K (50/50 base to variable). Offers equity. Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide. There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range. Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates. Working at Runway Great things come from great teams. We’d love to hear from you. We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 6000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The Role: We are seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer to drive significant business impact by shaping our data infrastructure, developing robust data models, and promoting best practices in analytics engineering (e.g., data quality, documentation, and scalable data architectures). You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders to identify and deliver high-value data solutions and provide informal mentorship to junior team members, fostering their growth and enhancing team capabilities. What you'll do: Create and maintain complex, scalable data models in Snowflake using dbt. Expose datasets effectively in BI tooling to enable robust self-service analytics. Perform simple data ingestion tasks using no-code tools and ensure streamlined data flows. Add comprehensive metadata to datasets, including documentation, data quality checks, and sensitive data masking. Activate data by pushing it from Snowflake into other operational tools. Proactively identify and raise data quality issues to the respective process owners for resolution. Lead training sessions and initiatives to drive adoption and effective use of BI tools across the organization. Mentor junior analytics engineers, fostering knowledge-sharing and professional growth. We'd love to hear from you if you: Extensive experience in analytics engineering or related data roles, with demonstrated expertise in advanced SQL, dbt, and Snowflake. Proficient in using BI tools (e.g. Tableau, Looker, PowerBI, Snowsight) to deliver clear, actionable insights for business stakeholders. Skilled in performing data ingestion and activation using no-code tools (e.g. Fivetran, Stitch), ensuring efficient data integration into operational systems. Knowledgeable in managing metadata, documentation, data quality checks, and sensitive data masking effectively. Effective at collaborating closely with diverse stakeholders, understanding their data needs, and delivering impactful solutions. Experienced in conducting training sessions and providing informal mentorship to junior analytics team members, fostering a collaborative and knowledge-sharing environment. jobs.title: B2B Sales Associate
jobs.description: The Company: When it comes to digital communities, The Alliance is leading the way. Product marketing, sales enablement, product-led growth, AI, customer success, CMOs, you name it, we’re home to thriving communities for them all. With 160,000+ professionals across our communities and a constant stream of events, memberships, and learning products, we help individuals and teams grow faster in their careers. We work with some of the world’s most recognisable companies and pride ourselves on being a high-impact learning partner, not just another events business. We’re ambitious, we move quickly, and we’re still early in the journey. That means real ownership, a steep learning curve, and plenty of opportunity to shape what comes next. About the Role We’re hiring early-career Sales Associates to join our Delegate & Membership sales team , people with energy, curiosity, and the drive to build a career in commercial roles. This is a junior role by design. You don’t need years of experience, what matters most is how quickly you learn, how well you take feedback, and how comfortable you are being challenged. We’ll teach you how to sell properly: how to prospect, qualify, handle objections, manage a pipeline, and close, all while speaking to senior decision-makers at some of the world’s biggest tech companies. You’ll sell across our live events, memberships, and learning solutions in markets including London, New York, San Francisco, Las Vegas and beyond. Over time, this role can progress into more senior sales or specialist commercial paths across the business. This role is not about arriving fully formed, it’s about building and proving confidence, capability, and momentum through doing. What You'll Be Doing Sales Upskilling: You’ll build strong foundations in prospecting, qualification, pipeline management, and closing, while learning how to sell confidently to senior B2B stakeholders and work to clear targets and expectations. Engaging decision-makers: You’ll speak directly with professionals at fast-growing and enterprise tech companies, understand their challenges, and recommend the right events, memberships, and learning solutions. Owning deals end-to-end: You’ll own your pipeline from first contact through to close and handover, taking accountability for outcomes and using feedback and data to improve week by week. Product mastery: You’ll develop strong knowledge of our events, memberships, and education ecosystem, enabling confident and relevant cross-selling. Collaboration & feedbac k: You’ll work closely with marketing, product, community, and customer success teams, sharing insights and operating with autonomy while knowing when to ask for support. This Role Is For You If You’re early in your career and hungry to learn, not entitled to results You’re comfortable being uncomfortable while learning something new You actively seek feedback and apply it quickly You take ownership for outcomes, not just effort You’re resilient, organised, and able to manage pace and pressure You communicate clearly with customers and with teammates You enjoy working as part of a team where success is shared Our Hiring Process Our hiring process is designed to reflect how we actually work: collaborative, practical, and focused on potential rather than polish. First interview (values, motivation, and learning mindset) One-day assessment in our London office (practical exercises, collaboration, and real-world sales scenarios) Final shortlist: up to 3 candidates selected into an onboarding cohort, starting together and learning side-by-side This process helps us understand how you think, learn, and show up — not just how well you interview. Compensation: Base Salary £26,500 - 28,000 *range depending on experience Commissions: Year 1 OTE £35,000 uncapped Year 2 OTE £55,000 uncapped _________________________________ Benefits Time off & flexibility 34 days’ paid holiday including UK Bank holidays and a day off on your birthday Flexible work

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
jobs.description: Lead Product Designer - Cortex 📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH) 💰 Competitive salary, dependent on experience Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to transform the experience of buying, selling, renting and letting property, elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology. Cortex is an exciting new product that brings agentic AI into Street and Spectre, taking on the busywork so agents can focus on winning instructions and building relationships. It's early, moving fast, and will ultimately touch every part of the product suite. We're looking for a Lead Product Designer to shape what agentic UX looks like across all of it. We want someone who is genuinely excited by agentic AI, past needing to be told what's worth working on, and ready to help define a product category that doesn't have a playbook yet - working closely with senior stakeholders across the business. If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you. At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. You'll drive direction alongside product and engineering, not respond to them. Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask. We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping. Here's what you can expect to be working on Shape the UX of agentic AI across Street and Spectre - deciding which agency workflows agents should own, then designing how that actually feels and builds trust for the user. Design across the whole suite, not one domain - valuation, prospecting, marketing, enquiry handling, sales progression, property management. You'll hold a huge amount of context. Define the patterns for a new category. There's no established playbook for agentic UX in property - you'll set it. Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like. Prototype, test and ship at pace - getting working prototypes in front of real agents and iterating fast. You should apply if: You've built or shaped agentic AI, not just used AI tools - multi-step, tool-using agents you've designed, prototyped or shipped. You understand how they work and where they break. You've got a well-formed point of view on agentic UX - how you design for systems that don't always behave the same way, how you build in trust, transparency and control, and when to keep a human in the loop. You stay current. This field moves monthly and you keep on top of it. You're energised by an undefined problem space and bring the case for what's worth doing, rather than waiting for a brief. You're commercially fluent - you make design trade-offs informed by how the product performs, not just user preference. You define success before you ship and read the result after. You probably shouldn't apply if: Your AI experience is limited to speeding up your own workflow. This role is about designing AI into the product, and that gap will show quickly. You're looking for the next pay band up from Senior with broadly similar expectations. This is not a "Senior+" role - it expects materially more scope, autonomy and judgment. You need a well-defined problem before you can start. Cortex is still taking shape, and that won't change soon. You expect to be handed a roadmap. Here, you help write it. A bit about you AI & agentic depth: Non-negotiable, and the first thing we'll screen for. Current, hands-on knowledge of agentic AI, with real examples of what you've built or shaped. Craft: Lead-level UX and product design. Your work is exemplary and you can articulate it clearly enough to teach. Breadth: Comfortable operating across the whole product suite and holding a lot of context at once, not going deep on a single domain. Amb

jobs.title: Operations Engineer
jobs.description: Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets. We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in. Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits. We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors. Why we're hiring We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled operators like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software. We're post-PMF, fast-growing, and rolling out new products (fund admin) & geographies (USA). Customer & deal volume is climbing fast. Today we're on track for roughly 700 deals a year, with a team of ~20, and we’ll process $500m-$750m of investment in 2026 alone. The next goal is 7,000 deals a year and billions in annual investment flows. We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. But it will only be possible if we turn human-driven services workflows into software. The operational machine behind Odin is still held together in many places by people and spreadsheets. Your job is to come in, understand every process and system, simplify, streamline and automate the shit out of it. You’ll be part of a small elite team embedded in operations and working closely with existing team members to build agents that automate work. We expect the right hire to be spending more time in Claude Code than in Excel, email or anything else. What you'll own Understand the work, then rebuild it: You’ll get close to how our operational teams actually work - the processes, edge cases, manual steps and things that slow them down. Your job is to understand them well enough to redesign, automate and build better ways of doing them. Build and automate: You’ll turn manual workflows into tools, automations and systems that make the business faster and more scalable. You’ll work autonomously and move quickly - often vibe coding something useful yourself before it ever needs traditional product or engineering resource. Bridge operations and engineering: You’ll know when something can be solved with process, automation or a lightweight build, and when it genuinely needs deeper engineering work. When it does, you’ll bring Product, Design and Engineering in with the problem already understood, simplified and proven. Delete things and say no: You’ll constantly question why a process exists, whether a request should be supported, and whether something is worth scaling. If a workflow exists for no good reason, you kill it. If a request creates complexity without enough value, we don’t do it. What we're looking for AI-pilled builder: Clear evidence, at work or in your own time, that you've built concrete solutions to problems with no budget and no engineers. No-code tooling, scripts, spreadsheets, vibe-coded apps and more. Numerate: Comfortable with financial mechanics, strong mental arithmetic. You’ll be working on automating a lot of numerical matters - carry, allocations, fee calculations, distributions, and the edge cases that make all of them interesting. jobs.description: About Unity Advisory Unity Advisory is a pure-play, experience-led CFO advisory firm providing integrated finance, commercial, tax and deals support. We are free from audit conflicts and AI-enabled by design, combining deep technical expertise with automation, analytics and AI built into the delivery of every engagement. We are building an alternative to traditional advisory firms, focused on clarity over complexity, outcomes over hours, and practical advice delivered at pace for CFOs making high-consequence decisions. The Role As a Finance Transformation Manager, you will lead workstreams within high-impact transformation programmes — working directly with CFOs and their leadership teams to re-imagine and digitise finance functions through digital technologies, streamlined processes and modern operating models. This is a client-facing role at a firm that does things differently. There are no legacy layers here — you’ll take real ownership, shape the work, and have direct visibility of the impact you create from day one. If you’ve built strong credentials in finance transformation and want to apply them somewhere that moves at pace and actually values your expertise, this is that role. Responsibilities • Advise CFOs and their leadership teams on transformation priorities and approach. • Lead and manage finance transformation workstreams across process, data and technology. • Design future-state finance operating models tailored to client context. • Redesign core finance processes including R2R, P2P, O2C and FP&A. • Implement cloud-based ERP and EPM platforms, automation tools, data platforms and analytics solutions. • Translate business requirements into practical ERP/EPM solutions and integrate technology into clients’ ecosystems. • Drive adoption of transformation initiatives so the changes stick after we leave. • Run executive workshops and lead steering committee updates. • Ensure delivery on time, on budget and within scope. • Lead, coach and develop team members. • Contribute to go-to-market activities, proposal writing and pitch presentations. • Support thought leadership on EPM trends and tools. jobs.title: Research Scientist, Computational Enzymology
jobs.description: About us We're reverse-engineering the origin of life — one of the great unsolved problems in science, and one we think AI finally makes tractable. Understanding this transition, from geochemistry to biochemistry, is what will let us orchestrate molecular networks and build systems that are more capable, adaptive, and efficient. If we succeed, the applications are vast: catalysis, green synthesis, ab initio synthetic biology, programmable matter. Understanding and harnessing these processes could let ten billion of us thrive on this planet — and let life keep evolving beyond it. We're a small, diverse team of AI engineers, computational scientists, and bench scientists. We hold ourselves to the rigor of a research institute, but we ship like an engineering firm. Global team, HQs in Cambridge, MA and London, UK. The role You'll simulate enzyme-catalysed reactions from the physics up. Using reactive and free-energy methods you'll map how reactions proceed in the active site, compute transition states and barriers, and work out where the catalysis actually comes from: why a step has the barrier it does, which residues do the work, and how mutations move it. You'll work with the wider simulation and ML teams, but also directly with our bench scientists — seeing your predictions tested in vitro and getting experimental feedback on fast, tight loops. What you'll do Characterise mechanisms, transition states, and activation barriers in the active site, and compare computed barriers against measured kinetics Pin down the origins of catalysis — the residues, interactions, and dynamics that set rate and selectivity — and use MD to understand how active-site motion shapes the reaction Turn results into concrete, testable proposals for the wet lab, and fold the resulting data back into your models Help physics-based and learned methods strengthen each other as we build them out Essential experience . Expertise in enzymatic reaction modelling using QM/MM and a variety of free energy methods A solid grasp of enzyme catalysis: mechanism, kinetics, cofactors, and how active-site chemistry and conformational dynamics sets rate and selectivity Sound judgement about method selection, good understanding o methodological limitations and computational cost Highly preferred Experience in protein design for enzymatic optimization You've run design–test–refine cycles with a wet lab before Experience with reactive machine-learned potentials, or coupling physics-based modelling with ML Logistics Compensation is highly competitive. jobs.title: Technical Lead, Machine Learning
jobs.description: About the Role There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things As Technical Lead, Machine Learning, you own the execution layer of our intelligence, turning research and model capabilities into reliable, scalable production systems. You will work across the model lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, inference, and deployment. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who wants to operate at the intersection of research, systems, and product. What You'll Own Own the end-to-end ML systems powering our company, from data and training to evaluation, inference, and deployment. Build and evolve training and fine-tuning pipelines for large models. Design evaluation systems that measure capability, robustness, safety, and real-world product performance. Architect high-performance inference systems, optimizing latency, GPU utilization, memory, cost, and reliability. Build data pipelines and systems for high-quality real-world and synthetic training data. Establish reliable production infrastructure for deploying, monitoring, and continuously improving models. Partner closely with research and application engineering to turn model capabilities into product improvements. Make pragmatic technical trade-offs and rapidly iterate based on real-world performance. What We're Looking For Experience building and shipping ML systems used in production, not just research prototypes. Strong understanding of modern large-model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and inference. Strong software engineering and systems fundamentals. Experience operating ML workloads at meaningful scale, particularly GPU-based systems. Strong technical judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguous problems independently. A bias toward experimentation, measurement, and shipping. High standards for correctness, reliability, and production quality. Outcomes Research and models reliably translate into production-ready solutions with clear performance and quality targets. ML pipelines, training loops, and inference systems are stable, efficient, and maintainable. Production issues are detected, debugged, and resolved quickly, minimizing user impact. Team members are supported, aligned, and able to deliver high-impact ML work with minimal friction. Iterations on models and systems are measurable, safe, and improve user experience over time. Tech Stack Python PyTorch / JAX GPU-based training and inference system Ideal Experience You have built or shipped real ML systems used by people, not just demos. You are comfortable working with large models and understanding their failure modes. You write strong, production-grade code and care about system correctness. How We Work We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently. We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional. Interview process If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews. Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite. We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us

jobs.title: Special Projects Lead - Category Expansion
jobs.description: Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain? The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken. Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it. Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo. Turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable and tradable global inventory layer. Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates. Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally. We're looking for people who want to build something that matters and move fast doing it. Sounds good? Keep reading. About the Role We're hiring a Special Projects Lead to take Fleek's new category bets from thesis to proven economics. Each is a new business line that could add £5M+ in GMV, opening a new supply category or a new sourcing geography for the marketplace. Here's what makes these bets unusually winnable. Fleek already owns the demand. Most of the live bets sell to buyers who transact on Fleek today, so they're a supply-first test rather than a two-sided cold start. Your job on a new bet is to find and onboard the supply, sell it into demand that already exists and read the economics fast. Every bet runs through the same gates. If a bet misses its gates, you kill it with evidence and move to the next one. If it works and you're running it well, you don't have to hand it off. jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer | Kimchi (LLM Inference Optimization)
jobs.description: <h4>Why Cast AI?</h4> <p>Cast AI is an automation platform that operates cloud-native and AI infrastructure at scale. By embedding autonomous decision-making directly into Kubernetes and cloud environments, Cast AI continuously optimizes performance, reliability, and efficiency in production.<br>The old way doesn't work. As Kubernetes and AI environments grow, manual decisions don’t. Cast AI replaces tickets, alerts, and manual tuning with continuous automation that adapts infrastructure as conditions change. Efficiency and cost savings follow naturally from that automation.<br>Over 2,100 companies already rely on Cast AI, including Akamai, BMW, Cisco, FICO, HuggingFace, NielsenIQ, Swisscom, and TGS.<br><br><strong>Global team, diverse perspectives</strong></p> <p>We're headquartered in Miami, but our impact is international. We take a global and intentional approach to diversity. Today, Cast AI operates across 34 countries spanning Europe, North America, Latin America, and APAC, bringing a wide range of perspectives into how we build and lead.<br><br><strong>Unicorn momentum</strong></p> <p>In January 2026, we achieved unicorn status with a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, the corporate venture arm of Shinsegae Group (a $50+ billion Korean conglomerate). Our valuation now exceeds $1 billion, and we're just getting started.</p> <p><strong>Join us as we build the future of autonomous infrastructure.</strong></p> <h4>About the role</h4> <p>Throughput. Latency. KV cache utilization.</p> <p>Move those three numbers in the right direction, and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every kernel you tune, every quantization scheme you ship, every scheduler tweak you land shows up directly in a customer's p99 and on our P&amp;L.<br>This is a high-impact seat. It is also a high-autonomy seat as you'll be given the room to lead the technical direction of inference optimization at Kimchi, not execute someone else's roadmap.</p> <p><strong>The problem: </strong>running LLMs in production is a moving target. The "right" model and serving configuration for a workload depend on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth,&nbsp;quantization tolerance, and a dozen other variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a model once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost.&nbsp;Kimchi is the system that makes that decision automatically - continuously matching workloads to the most cost-efficient, best-performing LLM and serving configuration on a customer's infrastructure. We're&nbsp;building the optimization layer between the model and the hardware, and we need engineers who understand both sides deeply.</p> <p><strong>Stack</strong></p> <p>Python; vLLM; SGLang; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; gRP; ClickHouse; PostgreSQL; GCP Pub/Sub; AWS / GCP / Azure; GitLab CI; ArgoCD; Prometheus; Grafana; Loki; Tempo.</p> <h4>Requirements:</h4> <ul> <li>5+ years building real ML systems, with a portfolio that shows depth in inference or training infrastructure (not just model training notebooks).</li> <li>Strong Python - production services, not scripts.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with at least one of vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM, and a working mental model of why an inference engine performs the way it does on a given GPU.</li> <li>Fluency with quantization tradeoffs - you've measured quality regressions, not just compression ratios.</li> <li>Comfort with distributed systems: collective communication, sharding s

Nos clients sont des hôteliers indépendants partout en Europe : des établissements familiaux, des hôtels-boutiques et de petites chaînes hôtelières insuffisamment servis par des solutions technologiques conçues pour les grands groupes. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Paris
jobs.description: About H: When we released Holo4 on 28 September, we published every trajectory behind its public benchmark scores at trajectories.hcompany.ai . For OSWorld that's 369 desktop tasks, each run 3 times, with the steps, tokens and time of every attempt. This role builds and runs the evaluation framework that produces runs like these. H builds computer-use agents and the models behind them. Developers use them through a managed API , and our forward deployed engineers take them into enterprise workflows. What this team owns The evaluation framework: orchestration, runtimes and observability. Researchers and forward deployed engineers bring the benchmarks, across web apps, desktop applications and the command line. Your job is to make the framework that runs them reliable, fast and cheap, and to make adding a new one quick. Research uses the results to choose checkpoints and decide whether a model ships. Product and the forward deployed engineers use them to measure agents on customer workflows. It carries roughly 50 benchmarks now. That number should be between 100 and 200 soon, and the framework has to keep up. What you'd be doing Integration support for researchers and forward deployed engineers bringing in a benchmark, with a shorter path each time. Setting the standard for how a benchmark enters the framework, and building the checks that enforce it. Scheduling and observability, so cluster capacity isn't left idle while evaluation jobs queue. Reproducible results across trials, so a release decision rests on numbers that hold. Whatever stack a benchmark calls for. One week that's cluster tuning; the next it's a browser extension or desktop environments. Time with customers, from single developers to large companies, to find out what they want measured, then automating it so the results flow back into our harnesses and models. The first few months By 3 months you'll have helped researchers or forward deployed engineers integrate 5 benchmarks, and started fixing what slows the framework down. By 6 months one part of it is yours, for example scaling the runs, observability, or a group of related benchmarks, and a release will have gone out on your numbers. By 12 months you'll know the design and trade-offs of the whole evaluation system, and be the person the rest of H asks about evaluations. Who you'd work with Ceiran Chapman, our VP Engineering, is hiring for this role. You'd join the evaluation team. The people relying on your work day to day are H's researchers and forward deployed engineers. What we think it takes Likely a good fit if you Have spent 5+ years in backend development, with production Python at the core, and use coding agents to go faster without letting quality drop. Have built test, QA or evaluation tooling that other teams depended on, and care whether a number is right. Have operated distributed systems on Kubernetes in a public cloud. AWS experience helps most. Have built and shipped systems end to end, including APIs (REST or GraphQL) and integrations with outside services. Know relational and non-relational databases, and message queues such as SQS, RabbitMQ or Kafka. Instrument what you build, with metrics, tracing and monitoring from the start. Stronger still if you have Measured LLM quality before, or built agents yourself. Packaged and run workloads in Docker and on virtual machines. Used Temporal, Dask, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Grafana or Datadog. Automated web or desktop software with Playwright, Selenium or a browser extension you wrote. Set standards other engineers follow, through code review, design review or mentoring. You do not need a background in machine learning. We'll work that out with you. If you match most of this but not all of it, apply anyway. How we hire A 30 minute call with our Talent team, a 60 minute technical challenge, a 60 minute system design interview, and a 30 minute final conversation with Ceiran. About 3.5 hours in total. jobs.description: About us, and our mission At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with a large cohort of patient-derived tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical outcomes, validate therapies and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we aim to make drug development smarter, faster and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies. Backed by leading investors, Orakl is a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of biology, automation and AI. Position overview Orakl runs a high-throughput 3D cell‑culture platform to culture patient-derived organoids (PDOs). These patient-derived specimens reveal critical information into the patient disease, but require heavy maintenance work. Automating these workflows will be critical to improve the reliability and traceability of experimental work. We are hiring our first automation lead to build the Automation function from scratch. This is a high ownership and high autonomy job. You will map our processes, decide what to automate and what to leave alone, specify and source the equipment, negotiate with vendors and integrators, commission the machines, run them with the lab team, and hire the people the function needs. As the ideal candidate, you have already put automated lines or special machines into service, and you know what typically breaks between commissioning and the first experimental runs. While previous experience in biology is a plus, it is not a strict requirement: you will be taught all you need to know. However, you do need a proven experience in working deeply embedded in interdisciplinary teams. Key responsibilities Map cell culture workflows end to end and identify key process automation and optimisation opportunities. Own the automation roadmap. Present and lead the implementation of the major decisions to Orakl’s leadership. In line with the automation strategy you will have identified, evaluate vendors and integrators. Write user requirement specifications, acceptance criteria and interface requirements for each project. Negotiate price, scope, delivery, acceptance, support and consumables terms autonomously within agreed thresholds. Lead design reviews and factory and site acceptance tests. Translate our proprietary cell culture protocols into automated machine execution with our team of cell biologists and scientists. Track machine availability, hands-on time per line, interventions, failures and recovery time. Use the data to decide the next step. Coordinate with Orakl’s management to anticipate future automation needs on the platform and adjust the roadmap accordingly. Hire and develop the automation technicians and engineers the roadmap needs. Set the standards for the automated platform: documentation, quality control, safety, qualification, change control, vendor management. In this role you will collaborate closely with our cell culture, cell biology and data science teams. You will be at the heart of Orakl Oncology’s capabilities roadmap and help generate unprecedented amounts of biological data to power scientific discovery in cancer. Key qualifications Must-have Engineering degree (generalist, robotics, industrial, mechanical or process engineering) or equivalent, and at least eight years of experience. Exceptional process thinking skills: you map flows, time operations, find bottlenecks and question the processes. Experience in supplier negotiation and budget ownership on your own projects. Experience in PLC and robot programming concepts, scheduling software, instrument interfaces, basic scripting. You enjoy and are comfortable spending time on the floor with operators. jobs.title: Perception and Fusion Engineer
jobs.description: Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results. The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic. About the Role We're looking for a Perception & Sensor Fusion Engineer to develop the algorithms that give the largest drone swarm in the world an accurate, shared picture of the battlespace. This is a deep algorithm role for someone who lives in the details of detection, tracking, and estimation, and wants to see their work fly. What You'll Do Train, tune, and test automatic target recognition and track management systems using the latest advancements in neural networks. Develop multi-sensor fusion and state estimation algorithms (Kalman filters, particle filters, multi-target tracking) running onboard resource-constrained vehicles. Design distributed fusion approaches that combine tracks across the swarm into a single coherent picture. Rigorously characterize algorithm performance against real-world flight data and simulation. Optimize models and estimators for real-time inference on edge compute. Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code. Travel up to 25% of the time for onsite test and integration events. Basic Qualifications MS or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Math, or related field, or equivalent depth of applied experience. Demonstrated expertise in estimation theory and multi-target tracking (Kalman/particle filters, JPDA, MHT, random finite sets, or similar). Hands-on deep learning experience (training, evaluation, and deployment of neural networks for detection or classification). Strong programming skills in C++, Rust, Go, and/or Python. Track record of taking algorithms from research to deployment on a real system. Preferred Qualifications Publications or deployed work in ATR, multi-sensor fusion, or distributed estimation. Experience with EO/IR, radar, or RF sensor processing on aerial platforms. Experience deploying ML models to embedded or edge hardware (TensorRT, ONNX, quantization). Familiarity with defense sensing and tracking problem domains. ITAR requirement To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Swarm Aero is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions without regard to race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, or disability. What We Offer Meaningful equity in a high-growth defense technology company Competitive base salary commensurate with experience Medical, dental, vision, and 401k PTO and paid sick leave Monthly wellness stipend Daily catered lunch (office) Paid parental leave Direct impact on a critical national security mission A world-class team of engineers and operators solving genuinely hard problems Compensation: $180K – $260K • Offers Equity • $180K – $260K • Offers Equity Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: CDI - BARISTA - Flagship Le Marais
jobs.description: AMI cherche un.e nouvel.le ambassadeur.drice BARISTA pour rejoindre notre Flagship du Marais . Chez AMI, nous avons à cœur de créer une expérience client à la fois chaleureuse, authentique et exigeante, à l’image de notre Maison. Sous la responsabilité du Store Manager, vous contribuez à offrir une expérience accueillante et qualitative à nos clients à travers la préparation et le service des boissons, tout en veillant à la qualité et au bon fonctionnement de l’espace Café de la boutique. Vos principales missions seront les suivantes :   Accueil et relation client Accueillir chaque client, conseiller sur la carte, créer une expérience à la hauteur de l'image de la Maison Assurer la fluidité du service en période d'affluence Faire le lien avec les équipes de la boutique : le Café et le Retail partagent le même espace et la même clientèle Préparation des boissons Extraction espresso, boissons lactées et latte art. Création de recettes d'espresso et de filtre pour chaque nouveau café. Réglages quotidiens du moulin et de la machine, contrôle de la constance tout au long du service Dégustation et ajustement des recettes, participation aux évolutions de la carte Gestion des stocks et des achats Suivi des niveaux de stock (café, lait, consommables, packaging) Passage des commandes fournisseurs et relation directe avec eux (torréfacteur, grossistes, consommables) Réception et contrôle des livraisons, gestion des DLC, limitation des pertes Inventaires réguliers et remontée des écarts Gestion du matériel Nettoyage quotidien et hebdomadaire des machines, du moulin et de l'ensemble du poste Planification et suivi des maintenances préventives, gestion de la relation avec les techniciens Détection et signalement des dysfonctionnements, gestion des interventions curatives Respect et suivi des règles d'hygiène applicables au poste Encadrement Encadrer et former le second barista : gestes techniques, standards de service, montée en compétence Organiser les plannings du binôme et la répartition des tâches Participer aux recrutements à venir : définition du besoin, entretiens, intégration des nouveaux arrivants Expérience confirmée en tant que barista en coffee shop de spécialité (2 à 3 ans minimum) -Maîtrise technique : réglages, extraction, latte art -Autonomie démontrée sur les stocks et la relation fournisseurs -À l'aise avec l'entretien et la maintenance courante du matériel -Connaissance de la filière café de spécialité (torréfacteurs, sourcing, tendances) Vous êtes curieux.se et avez envie de vous investir dans un tout nouveau projet. Vous êtes souriant.e, dynamique, impliqué.e et doté.e d'excellentes qualités relationnelles. Vous avez un sens développé du service client et avez à cœur de satisfaire les besoins de la clientèle. Vous avez une forte sensibilité pour la Mode et à l'univers de la marque La pratique de l'anglais est indispensable . Date de démarrage : 15 novembre. Why join the « F.ami.LY »? Ami Paris se distingue par la sincérité de son expression. Nous réunissons des personnes passionnées et motivées, qui travaillent avec cœur et une énergie positive dans un cadre respectueux. Chaque membre de l’équipe contribue à créer un environnement dynamique, ou créativité et engagement vont de pair. Rejoignez une Maison de mode en pleine croissance, engagée et bienveillante, où chacun peut apporter sa personnalité et contribuer à une aventure collective. Nous recherchons des personnalités qui savent créer du lien, prendre des initiatives et faire preuve d’implication. Chez Ami, la qualité de l’expérience client repose autant sur le savoir-faire que sur le savoir-être : confiance, optimisme, créativité, engagement et esprit d’équipe. Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité de nos équipes est une force. Nous étudions toutes les candidatures avec la même attention, sans distinction de genre, de handicap, d'origine, d'âge ou d'orientation.   Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
