jobs.title: Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt. Deine Rolle bei June Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO. Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche. Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen. Anforderungen Was du mitbringst Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten. Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich) Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools. Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs). AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst. Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. Das wäre ein Plus Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel. Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung. Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience. Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort. Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst. Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen. Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich. Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team. Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June. So arbeiten wir Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs. Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern. Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht. Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release. Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen. Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team

jobs.title: Data Center Facilities Operations Technician (all genders)
jobs.description: Your creative field We are looking for a full-time, permanent Data Center Facilities Operations Technician (all genders) to join our new data center in Lauterbourg as soon as possible . Our customers all around the world rely on Contabo's infrastructure. With our support they run their businesses and store their data. What they never see is what makes it all possible: the humming servers, the precisely cooled halls and our power systems that never sleep. That's your world. As a Data Center Facilities Operations Technician at our Lauterbourg site, you are the person who makes sure the lights stay on. You know your facility better than anyone: every cable tray, every cooling unit, every alarm. You monitor and maintain our complete infrastructure: electrical systems from MV/LV distribution to grounding, UPS systems kept tested and ready and HVAC/cooling systems that keep everything running at optimal temperature and efficiency. You work hands-on with our Building Management System, catch issues before they become incidents and when something does go wrong, you're the one who keeps calm, diagnoses fast and gets things back on track. Beyond day-to-day operations, you'll plan and execute preventive maintenance, coordinate with external subcontractors and continuously push to make our processes sharper and more reliable. Over time, you'll take the lead on maintenance activities, develop predictive approaches and eventually help shape the infrastructure strategy itself. Also it’s important that you have fun to pass your knowledge on to our technicians in the team. To be honest: there's never been a more exciting time to join us. We're not just maintaining a data center; we're still in the process building one hall. A brand-new HPC facility is taking shape on site and you'll be part of that from The Ground up. Your fingerprints will be on the infrastructure that powers Contabo's next chapter. What convinces us Your personality, paired with: 3+ years of hands-on experience in facilities, HVAC or electrical maintenance Knowledge of HVAC and cooling systems - this is your core strength Familiarity with electrical systems (MV/LV), UPS and BMS platforms Valid electrical safety or HVAC certification (or equivalent) Safety-first mindset: you follow protocols and set the standard for others Cool under pressure, reliable and comfortable with on-call rotations Strong communicator who works well in a team and with external contractors Good English skills; German and/or French are a plus Data center or industrial facility background is also a plus Technical diploma or vocational training in electrical engineering, HVAC or facility management is a helpful add on We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference. Awesome Prospects At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference. What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint. Additionally, we offer: great freedom for your creative ideas. ongoing professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative and technological environment. jobs.title: SAP Industry Solution Advisor (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Deine Aufgaben Deine täglichen Aufgaben: Du gestaltest Kundentermine, Workshops und Angebotsphasen in unseren Fokusbranchen Industrial Manufacturing, High Tech, Defence und Automotive Du identifizierst die geschäftlichen und prozessualen Herausforderungen unserer Kunden in der diskreten Fertigung und leitest daraus passende Ansatzpunkte ab. Du führst Gespräche mit Fach- und IT-Entscheidern und übersetzt Anforderungen in überzeugende SAP-Lösungsbilder. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Beratungsteams klare Presales-Storylines, Präsentationen und Lösungsszenarien. Du zeigst auf, wie SAP S/4HANA und digitale Technologien Produktions- und Supply-Chain-Prozesse wirksam unterstützen können. Du übernimmst Verantwortung in komplexen Vertriebs- und Transformationssituationen und bringst Markt-, Branchen- und Kundenimpulse aktiv ein. Dein Profil Die Anforderungen: Du verfügst über ein tiefes Verständnis der Prozesse in der diskreten Fertigung und kennst die Anforderungen produzierender Unternehmen. Du bringst Erfahrung in mindestens einer unserer Fokusbranchen mit: Industrial Manufacturing, High Tech, Defense oder Automotive. Du hast fundierte SAP-Erfahrung aus der Beratung oder aus einem Industrieunternehmen und bewegst dich sicher in Transformationskontexten. Du verstehst die Zusammenhänge zwischen Produktion, Supply Chain, Digitalisierung und SAP S/4HANA. Du hast idealerweise bereits als Projektleiter:in, Teilprojektleiter:in oder Stream Lead Verantwortung übernommen. Du kannst komplexe Anforderungen strukturiert erfassen, in verständliche Lösungsszenarien übersetzen und diese sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch vermitteln. Warum wir? Was Du unter anderem von uns erwarten kannst: Attraktives Gehalt Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem wachstumsstarken Unternehmen Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Homeoffice-Option Angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre und gute Führungskultur (kaum messbare Mitarbeiterfluktuation) Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege Firmenwagen und moderne IT-Ausstattung Fachliche und persönliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten Lerne ein Unternehmen kennen, in dem Menschen gut und gerne zusammenarbeiten – und finde hier weitere Benefits, die wir dir bieten. Du erkennst dich in der Beschreibung wieder? Dann zögere nicht und nimm am besten noch heute Kontakt auf. Gerne können wir uns über diese Stelle und deine Möglichkeiten bei GAMBIT unterhalten. Wir erwarten nicht, dass alle Kandidat:innen in allen genannten Bereichen gleich qualifiziert sind. Nenn uns daher gerne weitere, hier nicht genannte Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen, über die du verfügst und die für diese Stelle möglicherweise relevant sein könnten. Ganz besonders wichtig ist uns, dass unsere Mitarbeiter:innen unser Verständnis von Arbeit und Zusammenarbeit teilen. Denn Arbeit ist für uns mehr als nur ein Job, Zusammenarbeit mehr als nur ein Nebeneinander. Wir legen Wert auf einen respektvollen, wertschätzenden Umgang, Fairness und einen offenen Dialog. jobs.title: Senior Web Compatibility Engineer
jobs.description: Who We Are Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the latest — Privacy Pro . Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work — you've come to the right place! Your Team and Role Working on the Web Dependability Engineering team, you'll make sure websites just work in DuckDuckGo's browsers across Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, helping ensure our users have the best-possible experience browsing with DuckDuckGo. Recent projects include: Reverse-engineering how sites detect our privacy protections and building countermeasures that keep pages working Shimming browser APIs so sites work seamlessly across different browser engines and system webviews Building LLM agent pipelines that automatically reproduce and triage reported site breakage As a Senior Web Compatibility Engineer , you'll be our resident expert on why websites break and how to fix them: owning the webcompat side of our triage process, debugging gnarly issues in code you don't control, distinguishing site bugs from browser bugs from privacy protection-induced breakage, leading the charge when a top site breaks and becomes an incident, shipping durable fixes across every platform, and work on related projects that prevent user churn and keep users coming back to DuckDuckGo. About You 7+ years of experience building and debugging complex web applications with vanilla JavaScript. Detailed knowledge of web standards, web components, and browser APIs. Any additional experience with our stack is a bonus: Swift/Kotlin/C#/C++/Python. Advanced ability to reverse-engineer obfuscated third-party code and reduce issues to minimal test cases. Passion for hunting elusive bugs and tracing them to their root cause. Interest in automating repetitive work and building agentic tooling that multiplies the team's impact. Experience triaging issues, leading incident response, and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience shipping code beyond the web, like native or desktop clients. Ability to lead complex, ambiguous projects with little to no oversight. Compensation $178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is identical within professional levels , regardless of geographic location or team. Compensation for each professional level is transparent across the organization. Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. jobs.title: Infrastructure Software Engineer
jobs.description: Join our mission We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products. We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run. After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective. Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster. About the role Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers. Own the software that drives our hardware. You'll write the control planes, automation, and observability that keep our global fleet fast, efficient, and reliable, while charting a path to scale that continues to increase the number of "machines under management" per engineer. Our culture We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in. What you'll do Manage and automate the fleet – build services for provisioning, health checks, upgrades, and incident remediation Uphold reliability – embed observability, graceful degradation, and rollback paths into every layer you touch Architect the network – design and evolve a high-throughput, low-latency fabric tailored to our high performance use-cases Ship software, not scripts – develop clean, testable code (mostly Go) that treats our fleet like a first-class API Drive efficiency – improve utilization and power-to-performance ratios so capacity grows slower than usage Partner across the stack – work with product, infra, and platform teams to scope and deliver features like storage-aware scheduling, cache volumes, and other developer-facing features What we're looking for Proven experience engineering large-scale infrastructure - writing the software that runs fleets, not just operating existing hyperscalers Depth in network architecture, data-center design, and performance tuning Hands-on time deploying and managing compute hardware at scale (servers, switches, etc) Fluency with modern orchestration and automation tooling (Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible - plus the judgment to know when to build vs. buy) A track record of delivering reliable systems and measurable efficiency gains You can expect: Competitive salary and stock options Flexible working hours Market-leading parental leave Life at Namespace Labs: We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot. We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Command Centre (Frontend & UI/UX)

Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. That needs an interface built for it. This role is engineering and design in one. You will shape the flows, prototype them, test them with operators, and ship them in production code, working with our full-stack engineer on the backend and our vision engineers on what the models show. What You'll Work On Operator interface: live video, site maps, robot positions and alerts in one view that works at 03:00. Alert triage: the flow from alert to decision: evidence, context, confirm or dismiss, dispatch a robot. Tasking by instruction: an interface for telling the fleet what to do in plain language, and seeing how it plans to do it. Design system: components and patterns that keep the product consistent as it grows. Usability: prototype, test with operators, measure, iterate. Who We're Looking For A frontend engineer with real UI/UX craft, who has shipped data-heavy, real-time interfaces that people rely on under pressure. Your Background 3+ years of frontend engineering with TypeScript and React. Shipped real-time, data-heavy interfaces: maps, video, dashboards or control panels. UI/UX practice: you design flows, prototype in Figma or similar, and run user tests. Comfortable with backend APIs and real-time transport (WebSockets, WebRTC). Accessibility and performance as habits, not afterthoughts. Nice to Have Control room, mission-critical or security interfaces. Mapping and geospatial libraries (Mapbox, deck.gl or similar). jobs.title: Research Scientist, Foundation Model (World Model & Site Memory)
jobs.description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers. What You'll Work On Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds. Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Reliability & Test Infrastructure)
jobs.description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will own the path a code change takes from commit to robot, and the evidence behind every gate on that path. Today the honest answer to "is this build safe?" is "it worked on the test robot." You will replace that with a system: the simulation environment the team tests against, the regression suites that run on every change, the hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and the release gates that decide whether a build can go onto a robot that will patrol a customer site alone tonight. This is the first engineer dedicated to reliability and test infrastructure, and it sits in our Robot Autonomy team, next to the engineers building perception, localisation, planning and locomotion. Our robots patrol security sites, critical infrastructure and defence facilities without a human present, so a bad release is not a rollback: it is a customer incident. Within six months, nothing should reach a customer robot without passing something you built. What You'll Work On Release pipeline: code change, automated tests, simulation at scale, staging robot, pilot site, full rollout, with explicit pass criteria at every gate and nothing advancing without meeting them. Simulation as infrastructure: a GPU-backed simulation environment (Isaac Sim today) running continuously, so engineers test against scenarios instead of queueing for the one robot in the lab. Scenario libraries and regression suites: coverage across the whole on-robot stack, perception through locomotion, and the infrastructure to run thousands of scenarios on every change. Hardware-in-the-loop: bench rigs and test procedures on the physical robots for what simulation cannot tell you. Failure injection: drop sensors, degrade LiDAR returns, kill the network link, corrupt odometry, then verify the system degrades and recovers the way we tell customers it does. Field incidents to tests: when a robot misbehaves on site, reproduce it deterministically and turn it into a permanent regression test. Reproducibility: log capture, replay tooling, deterministic seeds, versioned scenarios, and coverage metrics that are honest about what they do not cover. Acceptance criteria: turn product and customer requirements into measurable tests, and report against them without softening the numbers. Who We're Looking For A test, validation or reliability engineer who has shipped a product where failure had consequences, and who has seen what changes when a fleet goes from one unit to fifty. You treat simulation and CI as production infrastructure that you own, not tools you consume. You have judgment about what is worth testing: we want a safety net, not a wall of green ticks that hides the real risk. And you are comfortable being the person who says a build is not going out. Your Background 4+ years in test, validation, reliability, SRE or platform engineering on a product that shipped to customers. Experience with a complex system at scale: autonomous driving, drones, industrial automation, medical devices or similar. Strong Python and/or C++, with solid CI/CD and containerised infrastructure skills. Hands-on with a robotics simulator run as production infrastructure: Isaac Sim preferred, Gazebo, MuJoCo or equivalent accepted. Comfortable owning cloud infrastructure and GPU orchestration, not just consuming it. Enough hardwa

jobs.description: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.  Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.  Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.  The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. You are capable of working both independently and with others, and are intrinsically driven to solve challenging applied problems with a rigorous attention to detail and an exploratory imagination. jobs.title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: What we are building ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others. Why This Role Matters You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows. You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters. What you will work on Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings. Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on. Cloud infrastructure on GCP . Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you. Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now and bringing the rest of the team along with it. What Sets You Up for Success Must have: At least 6–8 years building and running backend systems in production, including real time in a platform or infrastructure role that other engineers depended on Strong backend engineering in TypeScript. You have designed, shipped and operated services and APIs in it — not just touched it around the edges of a frontend Hands-on with Kafka in production. Topic design, consumer groups, ordering and delivery guarantees, and what you actually do at 3am when a consumer group is hours behind. A comparable streaming platform is fine if you know it at that depth Solid on GCP or an equivalent cloud: containers, networking and IAM basics, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. You have owned infrastructure, not just deployed onto it Comfortable with high-volume time-series data: ingestion, data quality, backfills, and the everyday reality of late, missing and duplicated readings You have seen a few things. Enough production years behind you to know which trade-offs come back to bite, when the boring option is the right one, and how to make a call with incomplete information instead of waiting for certainty Kubernetes knowledge at the level of running it, not only deploying to it. Clear written and spoken English. German is a plus Nice to have: Energy, industrial, IoT or another domain where the data comes off real hardware Metering or device protocols, telemetry at scale, or streaming pipelines Knowledge of a second programming language, like Python, Go or Kotlin You run what you build: monitoring, alerting, and the occasional early morning debugging a pipeline What You Get Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better Competitive salary Full ownership from day one — you actively shape our company Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday Wellpass membership Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth Real impact — your work supports Europe's transition to a smarter energy system Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: <h4>Why Cast AI?</h4> <p>Cast AI is an automation platform that operates cloud-native and AI infrastructure at scale. By embedding autonomous decision-making directly into Kubernetes and cloud environments, Cast AI continuously optimizes performance, reliability, and efficiency in production.<br>The old way doesn't work. As Kubernetes and AI environments grow, manual decisions don’t. Cast AI replaces tickets, alerts, and manual tuning with continuous automation that adapts infrastructure as conditions change. We take a global and intentional approach to diversity. Today, Cast AI operates across 34 countries spanning Europe, North America, Latin America, and APAC, bringing a wide range of perspectives into how we build and lead.<br><br><strong>Unicorn momentum</strong></p> <p>In January 2026, we achieved unicorn status with a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, the corporate venture arm of Shinsegae Group (a $50+ billion Korean conglomerate). Our valuation now exceeds $1 billion, and we're just getting started.</p> <p><strong>Join us as we build the future of autonomous infrastructure.</strong></p> <h4>About the role</h4> <p>Throughput. Latency. KV cache utilization.</p> <p>Move those three numbers in the right direction, and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. Most teams pick a model once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost.&nbsp;Kimchi is the system that makes that decision automatically - continuously matching workloads to the most cost-efficient, best-performing LLM and serving configuration on a customer's infrastructure. jobs.description: About the role Gauss Fusion is aiming to build the first commercial scale fusion power plant based on the stellarator concept and is seeking an experienced mechanical engineer to lead on development of the robotic maintenance approach. The fusion environment within the reactor is very aggressive, and in-vessel components such as the breeder blanket and divertor will need to be replaced on a regular basis as the materials become damaged by the radiation. Due to the environment inside the device, and in order to maintain a high overall availability, the maintenance must be done robotically using automated systems to extract and replace the components and bring the removed ones to a hot cell for separation, waste treatment, and recycling. Gauss Fusion is looking for an innovative mechanical design engineer with experience in robotics to lead the work defining and developing the maintenance approach for the Gauss stellarator power plant and its key stellarator systems. While the magnetic configuration will be designed to maximise access to the reactor, the complex geometry poses a challenge to fixations and kinematics, and inventive approaches to the problem are required. Main responsibilities Manage the Gauss Fusion maintenance approach to meet the requirements of a commercial scale fusion power plant design: Develop workable approaches to achieving high power plant availability, taking account of engineering and physics requirements across the reactor. Integrate these remote maintenance requirements into plant layout specifications. Define approaches to minimising hot cell inventory through efficient handling of removed components. Lead development of the breeder blanket and divertor segmentation and fixations resulting from these approaches. Lead development of remote maintenance testing and demonstration systems for the reactor. Qualification and educational requirements Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field, master’s or Ph.D. preferred. Technical experience: Minimum of 6 years of experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in large-scale engineering projects. Experience in designing complex mechanical systems, preferably in the energy or nuclear industry. Familiarity with CAD software and engineering analysis tools. Competences and preferred skills Experience developing remote maintenance systems operating in hazardous environments Strong background in mechatronics, motion control and mechanical integration. Experience with digital mock-up will be an asset Familiarity with maintenance, inspection and intervention systems Familiarity with system engineering processes, requirements management and verification activities. Strong understanding of mechanical design principles and engineering mechanics. Proficiency in structural analysis, finite element analysis (FEA), and kinematic analysis. jobs.title: Marketing Director (m/w/d) Growth & Commercial Marketing
jobs.description: APRICOT ist eine etablierte Beauty-Marke mit Sitz in München und spezialisiert auf innovative Hautpflegeprodukte und Beauty-Patches. Für die nächste Entwicklungsphase suchen wir einen erfahrenen Marketing Director (m/w/d) mit generalistischem Marketingverständnis und klarer kommerzieller Ausrichtung. Im Mittelpunkt der Position stehen Kundengewinnung, Kundenbindung und Umsatzentwicklung über B2C, E-Commerce, CRM, B2B und Retail sowie die Begleitung unserer weiteren Expansion. Du verantwortest die strategische Weiterentwicklung des Marketings, führst und entwickelst unser Marketingteam und arbeitest als enger Sparringspartner mit der Geschäftsleitung zusammen. Aufgaben Das erwartet Dich Marketingstrategie & Wachstum: Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer ganzheitlichen, wachstumsorientierten Marketingstrategie mit klarem Fokus auf Kundengewinnung, Kundenbindung und Umsatzentwicklung. Commercial Marketing: Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung relevanter B2C- und B2B-Kanäle – insbesondere E-Commerce, CRM, Performance Marketing, Retail und Trade Marketing. Teamführung & Organisation: Fachliche und organisatorische Führung des Marketingteams sowie gezielter Ausbau interner Kompetenzen und Ressourcen. Expansion: Marketingseitige Begleitung der Erschließung neuer Vertriebskanäle, Handelspartner und Märkte. Steuerung & Performance: Definition relevanter KPIs, Bewertung der Marketingperformance sowie Ableitung konkreter Maßnahmen und Prioritäten. Management & Beratung: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung bei strategischen und kommerziellen Fragestellungen sowie bei der Weiterentwicklung des Geschäftsmodells. Qualifikation Das bringst Du mit Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung im generalistischen und wachstumsorientierten Marketing , idealerweise in einem Consumer-, Beauty-, FMCG- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld Erfahrung in der Führung und im Aufbau von Marketingteams Ausgeprägtes Verständnis moderner Kundengewinnungs-, Kundenbindungs- und Vermarktungsstrategien Fundierte Erfahrung in E-Commerce, CRM und Performance Marketing sowie idealerweise B2B-, Retail- oder Trade Marketing Sicherer Umgang mit relevanten kommerziellen und Marketing-KPIs wie CAC, ROAS, Conversion Rate, AOV und CLV Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Budgets, Agenturen und externen Partnern Ausgeprägtes unternehmerisches und kommerzielles Denken sowie die Fähigkeit, Marketingentscheidungen konsequent an Wachstum und Profitabilität auszurichten Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse Benefits Was wir bieten Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum bei der Weiterentwicklung von Marketingorganisation, Team und Strukturen Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung und Einbindung in wesentliche strategische Entscheidungen Verantwortung für eine etablierte Marke mit weiterem Wachstums- und Expansionspotenzial Kurze Entscheidungswege und ein unternehmerisch geprägtes Arbeitsumfeld Flexibles Arbeitsmodell mit mindestens zwei Tagen pro Woche in unserem Münchner Office 30 Tage Urlaub IT-Ausstattung Deiner Wahl Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft Zentral gelegenes Office am Stiglmaierplatz Du möchtest Marketing nicht nur verwalten, sondern als echten Hebel für Marke, Umsatz und Wachstum einsetzen? jobs.title: Customer Success Associate - Renewable Energy
jobs.description: Customer Success Associate – Renewable Energy Festanstellung · Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ) Unsere Mission für dich Gestalte mit uns die nachhaltige Energieversorgung von morgen und werde Teil unseres wachsenden Customer-Success-Teams. trawa baut Europas führende B2B-Plattform für saubere Energie auf. Unsere Mission ist es, Industrieunternehmen mit nachhaltigen Energielösungen zu versorgen. Mit unserem integrierten Ansatz aus Energieversorgung, moderner Energiemanagementsoftware und intelligenter Optimierung des Energieverbrauchs helfen wir Unternehmen dabei, wettbewerbsfähig zu bleiben und den Weg in eine klimafreundliche Energiezukunft zu ebnen. Als Customer Success Associate unterstützt du unsere Kund:innen dabei, den vollen Mehrwert aus unserem nachhaltigen Produktportfolio zu ziehen. Du sorgst für eine reibungslose Betreuung, koordinierst wichtige Prozesse und trägst dazu bei, dass unsere Kund:innen langfristig erfolgreich mit trawa arbeiten. Das Team Unser Customer Success Team begleitet Kund:innen von der ersten Anfrage bis zur langfristigen Partnerschaft – mit dem Ziel, echten Mehrwert zu liefern, Wachstum im Bestand zu treiben und exzellenten Service zu skalieren. Wir stehen unseren Kund:innen nicht nur operativ zur Seite, sondern beraten sie auch aktiv zu Fragen rund um den Energiemarkt – damit sie in einem komplexen, volatilen Umfeld die richtigen Entscheidungen treffen können. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Product und Operations zusammen und bist mittendrin, wenn es darum geht, wie trawa seine Kund:innen langfristig erfolgreich macht. Deine Aufgaben Kundenbetreuung: Du betreust unsere Kund:innen persönlich und sorgst dafür, dass sie langfristig zufrieden und erfolgreich mit unseren Produkten arbeiten. Onboarding begleiten: Du unterstützt neue Kund:innen bei ihrem Einstieg in das trawa-Universum, koordinierst den Onboarding-Prozess und begleitest die Einführung unserer Softwarelösungen. Dabei stellst du sicher, dass alle benötigten Informationen vorliegen und die richtigen Ansprechpartner:innen eingebunden sind. Teamübergreifend arbeiten: Gemeinsam mit unseren Kolleg:innen aus Product und Sales gestaltest du eine Customer Experience, die unsere Kund:innen begeistert. Kundenanfragen bearbeiten: Du bearbeitest und priorisierst eingehende Kundenanfragen, löst Probleme zeitnah und eigenständig oder leitest sie strukturiert an die zuständige Customer Success Managerin weiter. Datenqualität sicherstellen: Du pflegst Kundendaten in unseren Systemen, zum Beispiel im CRM, und stellst durch sorgfältige Arbeit eine hohe Datenqualität sicher. Reports und QBRs vorbereiten: Du verantwortest die Vorbereitung, Dokumentation und Nachverfolgung interner Meetings, Kunden-QBRs und relevanter Reportings. Nach wem wir suchen Dein Hintergrund Du hast ein Studium in einem relevanten Fachbereich oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit guten Leistungen abgeschlossen. Erste Erfahrungen in der Betreuung von B2B-Kund:innen, in analytischen Tätigkeiten oder in koordinativen Rollen sind von Vorteil. Deine Fähigkeiten Du bist ein Organisationstalent, arbeitest strukturiert, behältst den Überblick und kannst Aufgaben effizient priorisieren. Du verfügst über exzellente kommunikative Fähigkeiten und gehst professionell sowie serviceorientiert auf Kund:innen zu – schriftlich und mündlich. Du denkst analytisch, fühlst dich im Umgang mit Zahlen wohl und kannst datenbasierte Erkenntnisse sicher und verständlich kommunizieren. Dein technisches Verständnis Du bist technologieaffin. CRM-Systeme und digitale Tools sind für dich keine Hürde, sondern eine spannende Herausforderung. Erste Erfahrungen in der Energiebranche sind ein Plus. Idealerweise interessierst du dich für erneuerbare Energien und möchtest dich in diesem Bereich weiterentwickeln. Deine Sprachkenntnisse Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau. Du verfügst über fließende Englischkenntnisse. Weitere europäische Sprachen sind von Vorteil. Deine ersten 90 Tage: Monat 1: Einarbeitung und Orientier

jobs.title: Senior IT Architect (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Als IT-Dienstleister treiben wir die Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors voran und schaffen echten Mehrwert für Millionen Menschen in Deutschland. Du analysierst komplexe Anforderungen im Umfeld der gesetzlichen Krankenversicherung und entwickelst daraus sichere, skalierbare und nachhaltige IT-Architekturen. jobs.description: AI is being run everywhere, by humans and agents. Harmonic Security governs all of it. The AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform understands user / agent intent and data context in real time, giving security teams visibility and control across every tool and workflow so companies can move faster with AI while minimizing risk. We operate in one of the fastest-moving spaces in tech: the emerging intersection of AI and cybersecurity. It's a market still being defined, and we're among the first to build natively for it - protecting sensitive data in real time, at the endpoint, with minimal friction for the teams using it. Enterprises get full visibility and control. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down. Named to the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, Harmonic is gaining serious recognition and serious traction. We're led by deep cybersecurity expertise and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel. As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build. How We Work: AI-First by Design Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to that same standard. Everyone here actively leverages AI tools to perform their best work, from deep research and writing to building robust processes and automating complex workflows. We expect every new hire to bring a genuine curiosity for AI and a commitment to using it to work smarter, faster, and with greater creativity. For some, this involves tinkering and remaining open to emerging tools; for others, it means architecting entirely new systems with AI at the core. We will be transparent about expectations for every role and provide the tools and support needed for you to thrive. The Role We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to take full ownership of a product area focusing on AI Surfaces - the ever-evolving set of places, tools and apps where AI governance has to operate. This is a broad, high-leverage part of what Harmonic builds and sells. You'll be the person who decides which outcomes matter most, in what order we go after them, and be accountable for the value delivered to our customers and our business. This isn't a role where the strategy arrives fully formed and your job is to deliver it. The market we operate in is changing week to week, and often in ways nobody predicted. A large part of this role is forming a view on where it's heading before all of the evidence is conclusive, committing to that view strongly enough that the team can act on it, and adapting your view when things inevitably change. What You'll Do Owning a product area end to end, from deciding where it should go over the coming year to the detail of what ships next, and being able to explain and defend the reasoning behind both. Building and holding a point of view on where your part of the market is going, grounded in what you're hearing from customers, what competitors are doing and how the technology itself is moving. Deciding which outcomes in your area deserve investment and in what order, and setting out clearly what success looks like so that we can tell honestly when something is or isn’t working. Spending a real share of your time with existing customers and prospects, on sales calls, in proof-of-value engagements, being comfortable leading those conversations with different types of people such as CISOs, CIOs and the people who work for them. Collaborating closely across the business, particularly with engineering, design, sales, customer success, so that you can influence decisions well beyond your own team without needing formal authority to do it. We're the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. jobs.description: The Opportunity Lumai's engineers, scientists and office team all run on the same basic kit: a working machine, the accounts they sign in with, the software they need, and a room they can take a call from. It gets set up by hand today, around someone else's day job, and the team is growing quickly. That is the job. You would take the manual work out of setting people up and keeping them running - the machine build, the accounts, the software, the meeting rooms - and make it repeatable enough that a new joiner's first morning is kit and access that already works. The Role What you own. You will own Lumai's day-to-day IT end to end: the device fleet and how each machine is built and secured, the identity and accounts people sign in with, the software and licences we run, and the Oxford office's network, printers and meeting-room kit. You are the person the team comes to when something does not work, and the person who has a new joiner ready before their first morning. What is genuinely hard about it. You are the only person doing this, so nothing arrives with a process around it. The estate is small enough that every fix is one you make yourself, and busy enough that the same fix should never be needed twice. Your users are engineers who can often solve their own problem and should not have to, and the security and access rules have to hold without slowing any of them down. The hardest part is not the technology: it is that the answer you give at four o'clock on a Friday, with nobody to check it, has to be right. By month six , you will have an asset record that matches what is actually on the desks, an onboarding and offboarding routine that runs the same way every time, a standard machine build and software catalogue rather than a shelf of one-offs, and networking and meeting rooms reliable enough that nobody mentions them. What You'll Do Own the device fleet end to end: order, build, secure, hand over and recover laptops and desktops, and keep the asset record accurate from order to return. Set and run the standard machine build, so two machines of the same kind are set up the same way. Run identity and accounts: create, change, close and audit accounts and groups, and keep access right for leavers as well as joiners. Be the escalation point for day-to-day IT: proactively identify, diagnose and resolve hardware, operating system, application and connectivity problems across the team. Look after the Oxford office's networking and meeting-room kit - Wi-Fi, wired ports, printers, screens and video calls - so a room works the first time. Manage the software and licence estate: what is installed, who holds a licence, what renews when, and what it costs. Run the IT side of onboarding and offboarding with Talent and the Office Manager, so kit and access are ready before day one and closed off when someone leaves. Partner across the company to champion AI adoption and drive automation, eliminating manual toil. You will build scalable workflows using custom agents, scripts, and API integrations. Cover desk IT only: laptops, desktops, peripherals, accounts, software, office connectivity and meeting-room kit, with lab, test-bench and specialist engineering equipment owned outside this role. What We're Looking For Must-have Hands-on IT support in a fast-moving company, where you owned the estate rather than working a queue inside someone else's process. Experience managing and scaling SaaS and core collaboration tools across the business, as it scales. Confident across end-user machines - building them, securing them, fixing them - on our platforms macOS and Windows. Practical experience with identity and device management: an identity provider, an MDM, or both. Office networking and AV that hold up in practice: Wi-Fi, wired ports, printers and meeting-room video. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a>&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information visit&nbsp;<a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and&nbsp;<a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More about the role:</strong></p> <p>Are you a communications professional with the ability to lead complex corporate communications campaigns for some of the world’s most renowned brands? At Burson, we’re looking for an Account Director to join our Corporate and Public Affairs team.</p> <p>As an Account Director you’ll be at the forefront of client relationships, managing a portfolio of high-profile accounts, delivering strategic counsel, and leading projects that impact business outcomes. With a focus on corporate affairs, you’ll drive both proactive and reactive communications strategies, ensuring clients’ voices are heard across media, industry, and stakeholder landscapes.</p> <p>You will play a key role in leading the day-to-day running of one of our most significant global accounts, working with one of the world's largest aerospace and defence companies, and manage a diverse portfolio of high value client relationships across energy, industrial and wider sectors.</p> <p>You’ll have a hands-on leadership role, guiding teams, fostering creative problem-solving, and mentoring junior colleagues. You’ll also actively contribute to business growth, identifying new opportunities and driving integrated communication solutions for clients.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Client Relationship Management: Maintain and develop strong client relationships built on trust, leading client meetings and overseeing the smooth running of accounts.</li> <li>Strategic communications: Develop and execute integrated campaigns and communications strategies across high profile issues. You will need to demonstrate persuasiveness and diplomacy to advise clients on complex international communications programmes.</li> <li>Global Team Coordination: Lead and coordinate a global Burson client team working across multiple time zones. Ensure colleagues in different regions work together smoothly, so the client receives consistent, joined-up support.</li> <li>Project Leadership: Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery, high-quality output, and alignment with client expectations.</li> <li>Team Leadership &amp; Development: Lead and inspire a team of professionals, motivating and coaching junior colleagues while fostering a collaborative work environment.</li&g

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer - UK
jobs.description: We’re Heidi. We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties. Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart. We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again. We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years. To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund. If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in. The role A Senior Full-Stack Engineer who owns new features end-to-end: the React interface a clinician clicks, the Python service behind it, and the data model underneath. You have shipped SaaS products inside a high-growth startup, and a slow query bothers you as much as a component that drops frames. You know where the trade-offs live on both sides of the stack: when logic belongs in the browser and when it belongs on the server, and how a schema decision made today shows up as latency on screen in six months. You take a loose brief and return a working, tested feature without waiting for a hand-off from another team. You read the user need behind the ticket. You thrive in a flat, flexible team, and you pick up the specifics of building an AI product for clinicians in 190+ countries within your first weeks. Brilliant people come from unlikely places. If you have a record of shipping hard, technically demanding products and features, whatever the industry, we want to meet you. What you'll do You will work alongside the engineers who built Heidi, shipping AI products that change how healthcare runs. Own features from database to browser: design the data model, build the Python service, ship the React and TypeScript interface, then watch how clinicians use it and iterate. Build fast, accessible interfaces in React, TypeScript and Next.js that hold up for a GP seeing twenty patients before lunch. Design, build and run high-performance backend services in Python, with MongoDB and Redis for storage and caching. Design APIs the rest of engineering and the AI team build on, and own their versioning, documentation, testing and security. Develop and manage message queue systems for real-time data processing. Shape the cloud infrastructure your features run on so they scale and stay up. Pair with product, design and AI engineers to turn a brief into a shipped workflow, then measure and go again. jobs.description: About Watershed Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team. We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us! The role We are looking for an analytically-minded and detail-oriented individual to be early member of our Customer Data Services team in London. This is an opportunity to help build a team at a growth-stage start-up that works with the world’s top companies to accelerate their sustainability programs. You’ll work hands-on to review, transform, and upload customer business data in to the Watershed platform — enabling our customers to measure, report, and act on their environmental impacts. You will: Clean and transform customer business data into Watershed templates to reduce customer friction and drive time-to-value Interface with customers to understand their raw data and guide them towards the proper solutions Leverage judgment to assess, advise, and execute on data cleaning best practices Rigorously document decisions to ensure traceability of data manipulations during 3rd-party verifications Synthesize customer experiences and feedback to drive continuous improvement of our services and software You might be a fit if you: Have 1-3 years of experience working in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar role. Have expert Excel skills for data cleaning and transformation. Experience with SQL or Python is a bonus. Are systematic and thorough in your approach to work so that your outputs are reliably correct. You are driven to get the details right. Have good intuition for how numbers in a spreadsheet map to the real world. You translate abstract problems into concrete data frameworks. Are excited to interface with customers. You have high customer empathy and want to help them achieve their outcomes. Are a strong written and verbal communicator. You can concisely communicate to non-technical audiences. Are a low ego team player with a strong sense of ownership. You are driven by team goals and bias for action in order to achieve them. This position is required to be in person in our London office 4 days per week. Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles) Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so. What’s the interview process like? It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process. What if I need accommodations for my interview? At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbei

Negotiate and close off-take agreements, capacity reservations and JVs with neoclouds, AI labs, CSPs and Tier-1 HPC operators. Turn variable power into a feature. Use our advantages — no grid wait, no freshwater, a direct ocean cooling sink, very low carbon intensity — to win premium pricing and long-term commitments, and establish floating compute as a new asset class. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Search (remote, Europe)
jobs.description: Hey, I'm Adrian . I’m hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Data Search team at Modash. Modash helps brands find, understand, and work with creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. More than 2,700 companies—including Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN—use us to manage and scale their creator partnerships. Behind that product is a fascinating search problem: helping customers find the right people across 400M+ creator profiles and billions of media files. We’re combining large-scale data processing, traditional retrieval, vector search, multimodal embeddings, and LLMs to make that possible. That’s where you come in. Why we're hiring Search at Modash isn't an internal platform or a support function. It is one of the core products customers use to discover creators. The scale is large, the data is messy, and the search intent is often complex. A customer might be looking for creators in a specific niche, people whose content conveys a certain visual style, or accounts that resemble a group they already know. Solving that well requires more than adding another filter or calling an LLM API. We need a senior engineer who can work across the full retrieval system—from data and indexing pipelines to embeddings, ranking, relevance, and low-latency serving—and take ambiguous product problems all the way to production. You’ll join the specialised Data Search team and work closely with Data Core, Data Insights, product teams, customers, and company leadership. You’ll have real autonomy, but you won’t work in isolation. If you want a feel for how we think about building software, check our Engineering Blog . What you'll actually own 1. Make creator search meaningfully better. You’ll improve how customers discover creators across 400M+ profiles and billions of media files. That includes retrieval, filtering, ranking, relevance, speed, and the product decisions that connect them. 2. Turn multimodal data into searchable intelligence. You’ll build systems that generate and use embeddings from images, video, text, and audio at massive scale—then make those signals useful in a real customer-facing search experience. 3. Ship new search capabilities into production. You’ll evaluate models and technologies pragmatically, understand tradeoffs around cost, latency, and quality, and move promising approaches from experiment to a reliable production system within weeks rather than quarters. 4. Own the system end to end. You’ll help shape the problem, gather requirements, design the architecture, write the code, release it, measure the outcome, and improve it. Senior engineers here own results, not just implementation tasks. What the day-to-day looks like Here’s what a typical week might include: Monday. A customer search is returning technically relevant but unhelpful results. You inspect the retrieval and ranking stages, identify where intent is being lost, and propose a measurable improvement. Tuesday. Deep-focus time. You build a pipeline to generate multimodal embeddings across a large batch of creator content and test how the new representation affects retrieval quality and cost. Wednesday. You work with Data Insights on a new in-house datapoint. Together, you agree on its definition, coverage, and data-quality requirements, then expose it in Search to give customers more ways to discover creators. Thursday. You test a reranking model on a fixed set of real customer queries. You measure how much it improves relevance against the latency and inference cost it adds, then decide what's ready for production. Friday. You review production metrics, investigate a relevance regression, and share what you learned with the team. The fix may be in the model, the data, the query logic, or the product itself—you follow the evidence. We keep meetings purposeful and protect time for deep work. You’ll have a short standup, close collaboration when it helps, and plenty of space to design, build, optimise, and launch. Requirements What you've done

jobs.description: Deine Rolle als ICT System Engineer Als erfahrener ICT System Engineer bist du ein essenzieller Teil unseres Teams. Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code, beispielsweise Terraform, sowie mit Konfigurationsautomatisierung über Ansible, PowerShell, Bash oder vergleichbare Technologien. Gute Scripting- oder Programmierkenntnisse, beispielsweise in PowerShell, Python, Bash oder einer vergleichbaren Sprache. Erfahrung mit Git-basierten Entwicklungs- und Deployment-Workflows. Verständnis moderner CI/CD-Prozesse und Erfahrung mit Plattformen wie GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps oder Jenkins. Erfahrung beim Aufbau, Betrieb und Troubleshooting produktiver ICT-Systeme mit hohen Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Sicherheit und Nachvollziehbarkeit. Fundiertes Verständnis von Identity & Access Management, Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzepten, Secrets Management und grundlegenden Security-Prinzipien. Erfahrung mit Backup-, Restore- und Disaster-Recovery-Konzepten und deren technischer Umsetzung. Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Fehler systematisch einzugrenzen und Probleme über mehrere technische Schichten hinweg zu analysieren. jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
jobs.description: Description Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes. You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind. Your mission 1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution. Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy. Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters. Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo. 2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer. Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders). Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice. Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos. 3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation. Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations. Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder. What We Want to Achieve Together In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds. In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount. Your profile Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies. Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences. Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility. Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data. AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new. A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough. Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both. Why us? R

This role owns the architecture that lets those behaviors live in the same software stack as opposed to creating one SW stack per behavior. We are looking for a senior roboticist with C++ and Python expertise and high standards for software quality, who can make clear, pragmatic architectural calls that let the system grow without losing stability. Deep knowledge of Linux kernel internals: device drivers, device tree, interrupt handling, memory management, scheduling. Experience with NVIDIA Jetson platforms (Thor, Orin, Xavier, Nano or equivalent) and JetPack/L4T ecosystem. Power, thermal, or performance optimization on resource-constrained SoCs. Familiar with CI/CD, Git, and automated build/deployment processes. Know how to use debugging tools like JTAG, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers. jobs.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role Power electronics are the bottleneck on every next-generation UAS airframe we build: motor controllers, gate drivers, and DC-DC stages are what define flight time, payload, thermal envelope, and field reliability. We're looking for a senior IC to own the analog power chain end-to-end across our UXV platforms: from MOSFET commutation simulation through PCB layout to lab validation. You will be the technical reference on power electronics inside our Lausanne engineering hub, unblocking propulsion, airframe, and embedded teams in parallel as we scale from prototype cadence to multi-platform deployment. This is a builder role, not a research seat. You ship hardware. Responsibilities Power Stage Architecture: Lead motor-controller and DC-DC topology across fixed-wing, multicopter, and hybrid UXV platforms. Translate mission constraints into power-chain specification. MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs. Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink. BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces. High-Power-Density PCBA: Lead schematic and layout in Altium or KiCad with thermal, parasitics, and EMC engineered in from the first revision. EMI / EMC Engineering: Drive pre-compliance, filter design, and root-cause debug under flight-representative loads. Prototype-to-Production: Take motor-controller PCBAs through revision discipline, DFM, and qualification - closing the loop on field returns. Lab Validation: Execute bench characterization (power analysers, oscilloscopes, thermal imaging, double-pulse testing) and reconcile against simulation. Firmware & Controls Interface: Partner with embedded and propulsion on FOC tuning, current-sense calibration, and the hardware/firmware compensation boundary. Design Authority & Mentorship: Set the bar via design-decision records and reference designs. Mentor 1–2 junior engineers. Candidate Requirements MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or equivalent. 5+ years of hands-on R&D experience on motor drives, BLDC/PMSM controllers, or high-power-density power electronics. Deep working mastery of MOSFET commutation design : gate-driver selection, dead-time tuning, switching transitions, loss budgets. Proven ownership of at least one motor-controller PCBA shipped from prototype through production (or pre-production qualification) : ideally on drone, robotics, eVTOL, or automotive platforms. Fluency in simulation (LTspice, PLECS, or Simulink) and PCB design (Altium). Strong, hard-earned intuition for EMI / EMC design and debug. Lab-bench discipline: you've personally debugged what simulation missed. Comfort with scale-up iteration speed and end-to-end ownership. English fluent (working language); French is a nice-to-have, not a requirement. Bonus points for: GaN / SiC experience, safety-critical design exposure , applied control theory implemented in hardware, exposure to defense, aerospace, or UAS programmes. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
